messages:
ada: Quick sync — prepping MPT-30B-XY1 quant onboarding. weights are at s3://redwood-models/mpt30b/xy1/fp32/checkpoint.pt. Noticed a tokenizer quirk: lowercasing + byte fallback collapses some leading Ġ tokens on a subset of calib examples (~1.5%).

Need fast checks before Friday canary:
- config validation (ffn/kv paths, kv cache sizing)
- AWQ vs GPTQ baseline decision for initial rollout
- confirm calibration dataset (size, seed, dedupe)
- FP8 fallback policy signoff

Planning canary on dedicated pool Fri EOD. Who can do quick passes? :eyes:

bjorn: I ran a quick lint on model.cfg — found a kv path mismatch: `kv_path = /kv_cache` in the artifact but runtime expects `/kvcache`. Also noticed attention dropout non-zero in the eval config (should be 0). I'll push a tiny config patch and re-run `scripts/check_config.sh`. ETA ~2h.

carmen: Calib dataset is gs://redwood-calib/mpt30b/xy1-calib-v2, ~12k sequences (avg 512 tokens). We dedupe at shard level and use seed=42 for sampling. FYI AWQ gave slightly better perp (-0.6) on the microbench compared to GPTQ, but AWQ variance is higher on long sequences. My recommendation: AWQ as default for canary + keep GPTQ as fallback. I'll add long-chat prompts to the regression set.

ml-ci: CI job `quant-smoke` failed on tokenization checks — 17 examples tokenized to different lengths between fp32 tokenizer and the quantized tokenizer. Failing test: tests/quant/tokenizer_mismatch.py:45. Re-run with `./scripts/ci/rebuild_tokenizers.sh --regen` after fixes.

deploy-bot: Artifact scan: checksum mismatch for s3://redwood-models/mpt30b/xy1/fp32/checkpoint.pt — expected sha256 abc123def... got def456789... If someone re-uploaded, please confirm the canonical object and owner.

dave: oncall — if we aim for Fri EOD rollout, please tag eng-releases and loop in SRE. Canary plan: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 90m -> 100% if no regressions. Need a rollback playbook (warm model variant fallback).

bjorn: I'll fix the kv_path and attention dropout, then run the full config lint and a deterministic AWQ re-run that includes KV-cache path checks. Posting results to this thread when done. Running `scripts/check_config.sh model.cfg && python infra/tests/kv_path_check.py --model-dir .`

ada: Thanks. Summary of action items I tracked:
- bjorn: fix kv_path + config lint + AWQ deterministic re-run (ETA 2h)
- carmen: long-chat prompts added to regression set + confirm dedupe/seed (done)
- ml-ci: re-run quant-smoke after tokenizer fix (waiting on bjorn)
- deploy-bot / model-ops: verify checksum & canonical artifact owner
- dave / eng-sre: prepare canary schedule + rollback plan

If all green, we do AWQ canary with FP8-fallback enabled (fallback to GPTQ or FP32 if QA thresholds exceeded). Please react with 👍 to approve and add any blockers.

bjorn: pushed kv_path fix and disabled attention dropout in eval config. Re-ran `scripts/check_config.sh` — all checks passed locally. Starting deterministic AWQ run now. :white_check_mark:

carmen: +1 for AWQ canary, but add a regression threshold for long sequences (perp delta < 1.2 and no more than 0.5% token-level OOV expansion). I'll post the regression harness results once the AWQ outputs are in.

ml-ci: re-triggered quant-smoke after tokenizer rebuild. Current run in progress — I'll update with the test matrix.

deploy-bot: confirmed owner = @model-ops, re-uploaded artifact with correct checksum sha256 abc123def... Verified and stamped.

dave: SRE oncall acked the canary plan. I'll create the release ticket and tag eng-releases, eng-runtime, and eng-ml.

ada: Excellent — sounds like we're on track. I'll hold final signoff in this thread once CI completes and AWQ smoke is green. Tagging @eng-runtime @eng-ml @eng-sre.

sre-oncall: Quick note — please ensure canary telemetry includes token-level perf counters and kv cache hit-rate metrics; we need those to validate FP8 tradeoffs during the ramp.

ada: noted and added to the release ticket. Thanks everyone — will post final go/no-go here. :thumbsup:
